notes: Known (Israel 2015, in the entry): den B_{2^m} = product of primes 2^j + 1, j <= m (von Staudt-Clausen). Lean: A219196_15, A219196_16, A219196_17_32; general lemma bernoulli_den_eq_prod (den B_{2k} = product of primes p with p - 1 | 2k), reusable for other Bernoulli-denominator entries. Outside Lean: none.
